name: the_same_fire
conceit: The flagship $0-alignment-risk primitive: ONE neutral AI plate (a charcoal fire under flat even daylight, meant to be relit) is regraded TWICE by code alone -- a cool desaturated tight-radial-vignette pass for night (fear closes the light down) and a warm wide-open pass for dawn (grace opens it back up) -- literally the same pixels both times, so there is zero risk of two generations failing to match.

anti: an echo across two spatially or compositionally DIFFERENT subjects -- Same Fire only works when it is genuinely the same object/plate relit, not two different objects being compared (that is Correspondence's job, e.g. the_sounding_line)

plate_bill.must_contain: a small charcoal fire glowing in a simple stone fire-ring, rendered under flat even neutral daylight with no strong directional shadows, plain aged paper background, nothing else in frame

motion_slots.earned_by: if the narration's own turn lands on the fire (e.g. the exact moment of recognition), a single $0 cross-dissolve between the night and dawn code-regrades already covers the motion; a paid clip is only earned if the narration explicitly asks the camera to move rather than the light to change.

beat_template.hook: the fire, neutral, waiting to be relit
beat_template.pivot: the cold, tight, closed-down night regrade -- the denial
beat_template.landing: the same fire, warm and wide open -- the dawn regrade, grace arriving

score_shape: a cold, close, minor-key held tone under the night regrade, opening on the cross-dissolve into a warm, wide, major-key swell for the dawn regrade -- the score performs the exact same relight the code does.
